No ticket, no stop. Skip it. Revisit only if the concentration breaks down and sellers become a meaningful share of flow.
memos.scout:
I can't find an honest case for buying UDR at this moment, so I'm recommending a skip.

The brief shows an OPERATOR-class coin: one operator-linked group supplied almost all early liquidity, with bundle_share and top3_share at 1.0 and a top-5 buyer share of 0.9997. Roughly 7,000 SOL of buying came in within two minutes of graduation, and the sell-to-buy ratio was near zero. That is concentration, not organic demand.

The recent flow looks like demand, but it sits on top of that concentration. The last 15 minutes show 58 buyers and 238 SOL net inflow, yet the operator-linked wallets hold most of the supply and could exit into any new buyers. The +6.6% return and +16% over 30 minutes come from a pool where a few actors set the price.

The brief also notes that operator-backed coins have been roughly break-even on average, and this one has no drawdown yet, so there's no dip to buy. Against a 1.4 to 5.1% round-trip cost, a break-even base rate doesn't justify a $20 ticket, and the concentration risk adds a fat tail to the downside.

Recommendation: skip. Re-evaluate only if the top-holder concentration visibly falls and organic sellers appear.
memos.skeptic: The most likely way this loses money is insider distribution after an operator-controlled launch. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0, top3_share 1.0, and the first two minutes after graduation had 7,012 SOL of buys from just 20 wallets, with top-5 buyers holding 99.97%. A sell-to-buy ratio of 0.0002 in that window means almost nothing was sold, so the operator still holds most of the supply. The last 15 minutes show 58 buyers against 18 sellers, a +6.6% return, and net inflow of 238 SOL, but that flow is concentrated and easily reversed. A single operator exit, into a pool of only 7,567 SOL, would hit price far harder than our 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost. Market cap of $398M on a 31-minute-old coin is itself a red flag of artificial pricing. Skip.
